state:
Goal `tools-cli`: six features of `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md` now have all their proofs. This
session finished `nvs-info` and `the-compile-cache`. `nvs-info` reads no program, so its example
and attack are entries in `data/proofs/policy.json`'s `skip` table, each with its reason. Its
section said `nvs -i` gets an error naming `nvs info`. That was false, and the section now says what
the binary does. `bun nv proofs --owed | grep tools:cli` lists the seven features still owed. Two of
them also owe `help`: `nvs-build-compile` and `nvs-build-openapi`.

items.text: **`tools:cli/nvs-config-check-and-nvs-config-dump`** — owes examples, hostile, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md:304`. This is the first feature the driver's check names. Look for existing `nvs config check` or `nvs config dump` tests in `crates/nvs-cli/tests/` that need only a `// covers:` marker. The example is a program. Its comment says which `nvs config` command to run beside it.

**`tools:cli/nvs-build-compile`** — owes examples, help, hostile, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md:259`. For help, add a fenced block showing the command and what it writes.

**`tools:cli/nvs-build-openapi`** — owes examples, help, hostile, tests (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`). `docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md:280`. The attack for `nvs-api-diff` already builds routes that are hard to write into an API document. Reuse it only if the test for this feature needs different assertions.

backlog: `tools:cli/one-binary`, `nvs-run`, `nvs-check` and `nvs-test` each owe examples, hostile and tests (`docs/reference/tools/10-cli.md`).
`nvs info | head -1` in PowerShell exited 255, which may be a panic on a closed pipe (`crates/nvs-cli/src/info.rs:53`). *not checked* under a POSIX shell.

A compile cache directory under `target/tmp` is refused on Windows, because the check reaches its grandparent (playbook bullet). Whether that is intended belongs to `rule:config/ownership-is-the-trust-boundary`.
